I identified and saved a gap synthesis titled "Lack of evaluation of imitation learning methods under diverse environmental conditions" with ID d65811b7-9f3f-5544-8cde-9e84ee080ec7. 

This synthesis points out that while some papers highlight limitations of pure imitation learning methods for driving, and others provide datasets with diverse roads, lighting, and weather conditions, there is no evidence that those imitation learning methods have been tested across such diverse conditions. This represents a gap in understanding the generalization of learned driving policies to new environments.
